# KarnyNow input script fixture - the login timeline shape (round L, F19).
#
# This file is BOTH documentation and a gate: `knvstd --input-check=FILE`
# parses it (ctest: knvstd_input_check) and every command form the parser
# accepts appears at least once below, so a parser regression fails the build.
#
# FORMAT
#   <t_ms> <command> <args...>        '#' or ';' starts a comment
#   t_ms is relative to the FIRST MEDIA TICK of the draw (the moment input is
#   armed), not to process start - so the same file replays identically on
#   every lottery draw however long the queue took.
#
# COMMANDS
#   key   <vk|name|char> <down|up> [mods]   vk = 0x41 | 65 | A | enter | f13
#   type  <text to end of line>             one down/up pair per character
#   mouse <x> <y> <w> <h>                   absolute PIXELS in a w x h view
#   mrel  <dx> <dy>                         relative motion (rides sid 6)
#   btn   <1..5|left|middle|right|x1|x2> <down|up>
#   wheel <dx> <dy>                         one notch is typically +/-120
#
# THE GATE: nothing here flies before the activation chain latches
# enable-input(true) (run 31 proved the chain itself is live: 8/8 messages,
# 0 failures). Events that are due while the gate is shut are counted as
# `gated` and retried, never dropped.
#
# SECURITY: a real script holds a real password, so it stays on the rig.
# Nothing in this fixture is a credential - REPLACE the two `type` lines
# before flying, and never commit the filled-in version.

# ---- 1. wake the prompt and move focus into the e-mail field -----------
0     key tab down
30    key tab up

# ---- 2. the account name (placeholder - edit on the rig) --------------
400   type your.account@example.com

# ---- 3. Tab to the password field, then the password placeholder ------
1800  key tab down
1830  key tab up
2000  type REPLACE_WITH_THE_REAL_PASSWORD

# ---- 4. Enter submits -------------------------------------------------
3400  key enter down
3430  key enter up

# ---- 5. a named key with modifiers (AltGr = right Alt + Ctrl+Alt on the
#         reference's table; here a plain Ctrl+A select-all as the example)
5000  key a down ctrl
5030  key a up ctrl

# ---- 6. every remaining command form, so the parser is fully exercised -
# a click at 640x360 inside a 1280x720 viewport (the CM create body's
# resolution), a relative nudge, a wheel notch, and the two extra buttons.
6000  mouse 640 360 1280 720
6200  btn left down
6260  btn left up
6400  mrel -4 0
6440  mrel 4 0
6600  wheel 0 120
6800  wheel 0 -120
7000  btn right down
7060  btn right up
7200  btn middle down
7260  btn middle up
7400  btn x1 down
7460  btn x1 up

# ---- 7. the anti-AFK pulse, spelled out exactly as the reference sends it
#         (VK 0x7C = F13, no modifiers) - --input-anti-afk does this on a
#         timer instead, this is how you place one by hand.
9000  key 0x7C down none
9030  key f13 up

# ---- 8. arrow navigation (a login prompt is driven with these) --------
10000 key up down
10030 key up up
10100 key down down
10130 key down up
10200 key esc down
10230 key esc up
